chance.advance_to_go: Head straight to GO. If you pass it along the way, collect your salary.
chance.advance_to_illinois_avenue: Move ahead to Illinois Avenue. Collect your salary if you pass GO on the way.
chance.advance_to_st_charles_place: Move ahead to St. Charles Place. Collect your salary if you pass GO on the way.
chance.advance_to_nearest_utility: Move to the nearest utility. If it's unowned, you may buy it from the bank. If it's owned, pay the owner ten times your dice roll.
chance.advance_to_nearest_railroad: Move to the nearest railroad. If it's unowned, you may buy it from the bank. If it's owned, pay the owner double the usual rent.
chance.bank_pays_dividend: The bank pays you a dividend of $50.
chance.get_out_of_jail_free: A free pass out of jail. Keep this card until you need it, or trade it away.
chance.go_to_jail: Straight to jail. No stop at GO, no salary along the way.
chance.general_repairs: Time for repairs on your properties: pay $25 for each house and $100 for each hotel you own.
chance.trip_to_reading_railroad: Take a trip to Reading Railroad. Collect your salary if you pass GO on the way.
chance.elected_chairman: You're elected chairman of the board. Pay every other player $50.

community_chest.advance_to_go: Move straight to GO. If you pass it along the way, collect your salary.
community_chest.bank_error: A bank mix-up works in your favor. Collect $200.
community_chest.sale_of_stock: You sell some stock and collect $50.
community_chest.get_out_of_jail_free: A free pass out of jail. Keep this card until you need it, or trade it away.
community_chest.go_to_jail: Straight to jail. No stop at GO, no salary along the way.
community_chest.birthday: It's your birthday! Every other player chips in $10.
community_chest.street_repairs: Time for street repairs: pay $40 for each house and $115 for each hotel you own.
community_chest.beauty_contest: Second place in a beauty contest. Collect $10.
community_chest.inheritance: You come into an inheritance of $100.
